metrics.contentReach: Content reach relative to creator baseline
metrics.followUpReach: Follow-up reach relative to creator median

lowClickThrough.title: Test content packaging on items with below-baseline click-through performance
lowClickThrough.summary: A measured group of content has click-through performance below this creator's own median.
lowClickThrough.observation: Below-baseline click-through performance was observed in the supplied sample.
lowClickThrough.interpretation: Packaging may be limiting the conversion of eligible impressions; the evidence is relative to this creator, not a universal benchmark.
lowClickThrough.action: Run one controlled title or thumbnail test on the related content and compare click-through performance with the current creator median.
lowClickThrough.impact: Improved packaging should increase click-through performance if packaging is the limiting factor.

monitor.action: Keep current packaging and collect a larger sample.
monitor.reason: The current sample already meets the minimum evidence contract.
monitor.condition: Reconsider if the controlled test cannot isolate a packaging change.

strongReachWeakRetention.title: Align the opening with the promise of high-reach content
strongReachWeakRetention.summary: Content that reached an above-baseline audience also showed below-baseline retention.
strongReachWeakRetention.observation: Reach and retention signals overlap on the same content items.
strongReachWeakRetention.interpretation: The packaging attracted initial attention, but the viewing experience may not have sustained the promise for these items.
strongReachWeakRetention.action: For the next related item, test an opening that states the promised outcome early and measure retention against the current creator median.
strongReachWeakRetention.impact: A better promise-to-opening match should improve early viewing continuity while preserving reach.

packaging.action: Change only the title or visual packaging.
packaging.reason: Reach is already above baseline on the same content items.
packaging.condition: Reconsider if reach falls below baseline in the next measured sample.

publishingInconsistency.title: Adopt a publishing cadence based on the creator's observed median interval
publishingInconsistency.summary: Publishing intervals vary materially across the analyzed period.
publishingInconsistency.observation: The variation between publishing intervals exceeds the documented analytical threshold.
publishingInconsistency.interpretation: An irregular cadence may make planning and repeat audience expectations harder to sustain.
publishingInconsistency.action: Plan the next three publishing dates around the observed median interval, then compare interval variation with the current baseline.
publishingInconsistency.impact: A more repeatable cadence should reduce interval variation and improve operational predictability.

lowerFrequency.action: Use a less frequent but explicitly scheduled cadence.
lowerFrequency.reason: The evidence supports reducing variation, not a specific universal frequency.
lowerFrequency.condition: Reconsider if the current median interval is not operationally sustainable.

highPerformingPattern.title: Validate a follow-up to the measured high-performing content pattern
highPerformingPattern.summary: An exceptional reach signal overlaps with a recurring deterministic content pattern.
highPerformingPattern.observation: Recurring title terms appear in content that also exceeds the creator's reach baseline.
highPerformingPattern.interpretation: The overlap supports testing a related follow-up; it does not establish that the recurring terms caused performance.
highPerformingPattern.action: Publish one clearly related follow-up and compare its reach with the current creator median before expanding into a series.
highPerformingPattern.impact: A controlled follow-up can confirm whether the observed pattern remains useful for content planning.

series.action: Commit immediately to a multi-item series.
series.reason: One observed overlap does not prove repeatable causation.
series.condition: Reconsider after a follow-up also performs above the creator baseline.
